description: Project: Hail Mary is a team of 6 participating virtually in NASA Space Apps Cairo 2026. We're tackling the Field Shift challenge: using NASA Earth observation data to help farms adapt to changing climate and growing conditions.
summary: Egyptian Nile Delta farmers decide every year what winter crop (wheat, berseem clover, sugar beet, faba beans) to plant before summer rice, maize, or cotton under canal rotation scarcity, soil salinity, and MWRI Decree 26/2025 rice limits. Generic advice claims clover improves next-season rice, yet local block-level proof is scarce. Precrop Payoff Atlas turns 10 years (2016-2025) of NASA satellite observations into an interactive 90 m decision advisor across Sidi Ghazi (Kafr El-Sheikh, 34,682 blocks), Zankalon (Sharqia), and out-of-region Mallawi (Minya, 14,497 blocks). Using within-block switcher fixed effects on 17,371 Sharqia blocks, our worked example measures that rice after clover consumes +11.9 mm (+2.4%, ~50 m3/feddan; 95% CI 10.8-13.1 mm) more summer NASA ECOSTRESS evapotranspiration (~0.6M m3/year across the Sharqia study area) while showing no net late-season rice greenness gain once May-June clover carryover is separated.
details:
What We Built (Three-Lane Modular Architecture):

1. Lane 1 - Multi-Year Satellite Measurement Engine (pipeline/): Builds 28-day NASA HLS composites (2016-2025) on aligned 90 m UTM blocks (EPSG:32636), trains LightGBM and NASA/IBM Prithvi-EO-2.0 against FAO WaPOR crop maps (held-out LightGBM OA 0.819 on SGZ S2023; rice area within ~10% of FAO ground reference), ingests NASA ECOSTRESS daily ET, NASADEM elevation, NASA POWER agroclimatology, and OpenStreetMap waterways, matches ~10 analog blocks via 1024-d Prithvi embeddings, and estimates 10-year two-way within-block fixed effects with lead-placebo falsification.

2. Lane 2 - Causal Inference, Hydrology & Constraint Engine (science/): Runs cross-fitted Double/Debiased ML and R-Learner Causal Forests with 900 m super-block CR3 cluster CIs; executes 6 robustness checks (temporal placebo, 200-draw stratified permutation, [0.05, 0.95] overlap trimming, Cinelli-Hazlett sensitivity, 200-draw confusion-matrix misclassification propagation, agronomic direction check); computes FAO-56 Dual-Kc Eq. 62 water budgets; and enforces Maas-Hoffman salinity thresholds plus Egypt MWRI Decree 26/2025 rice legality. Standalone science/ passes 14/14 pytest tests (95% coverage), ruff, and strict mypy.

3. Lane 3 - Bilingual Farmer & Planner UI (app.py, ui_data.py): Live at https://precrop-payoff-atlas.streamlit.app/ in English & Egyptian Arabic (RTL) with a 3-step quick guide, 90 m block explorer across SGZ (34,682 blocks) and Mallawi (14,497 blocks, Decree 26 rice auto-blocked), optional user-entered EGP crop prices, M2 10-year charts, verification/confusion tables, and tool-grounded Q&A.

Honest Limits & Roadmap:

Estimates describe 90 m blocks (~1.9 feddan), not sub-pixel individual farms; we do not claim satellite soil-health measurements, ton/feddan yield, or causal separation of late May-June clover ET from early rice ET. Single-year SGZ v1 snapshots enforce Honest-Null Gate G3 (deferring full causal selection to Tab 2's 10-year panel). Out-of-region summer LightGBM drops on unseen Upper Egypt (MLL OA 0.36-0.38); next step is fine-tuning across more governorates.

Code & MIT Repo: https://github.com/Beshoy-Zaki/hail-mary-fieldshift
